description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the CompanyStructureService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods related to managing organizational subunits, such as retrieval, addition, deletion, and chain construction of subunits.

classes.name: CompanyStructureServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CompanyStructureService methods related to organizational subunits in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing the CompanyStructureService instance, defining fixture data, and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Subunit object by its ID through the service.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests saving a new Subunit object via the service.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a subunit under a parent subunit.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization name through the DAO via the service.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Tests retrieving the entire subunit tree.

methods.name: testGetSubunitChainById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the chain of subunit IDs from a specific subunit ID up to the root, including various nested subunits.
